local p = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local report = p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ReadabilityInventoryObserver") or Instance.new("StringValue")
report.Name, report.Parent, report.Value = "ReadabilityInventoryObserver", p.PlayerGui, ""
local s = Instance.new("LocalScript")
s.Name = "ReadabilityPickupObserver"
s:SetAttribute("corn_test_owned", true)
s.Source = [[
local H = game:GetService("HttpService")
local p = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local report = p.PlayerGui.ReadabilityInventoryObserver
local t, seen = os.clock(), {}
local conns = {}
local function record(kind, data)
    table.insert(seen, {t=os.clock()-t,kind=kind,data=data})
    report.Value=H:JSONEncode(seen)
end
conns[1] = game.ReplicatedStorage.GameRemotes.round_snapshot.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snapshot)
    record("snapshot",{inventory=snapshot.inventory,phase=snapshot.phase})
end)
conns[2] = game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
    if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.E then record("E",{processed=processed}) end
end)
conns[3] = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService").PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt)
    record("prompt",{name=prompt:GetFullName()})
end)
task.wait(20)
for _,c in conns do c:Disconnect() end
script:Destroy()
]]
s.Parent = p.PlayerScripts
return {observing_seconds=20}
